headline: Brazil Central Bank Tightens Credit Rules for Revolving Credit Card Debt
summary: Brazil's National Monetary Council (CMN) approved rules requiring banks to gradually reduce credit limits for customers who repeatedly rely on revolving credit card financing.
why: Regulatory interventions in consumer credit markets aim to curb household indebtedness and mitigate systemic delinquency risks for commercial banks.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Stricter banking regulations alter consumer credit availability and bank lending portfolios.
